item.description:
• WatermarkFactory now speaks Spanish — the whole interface (not just the chat's understanding of Spanish input) follows your Mac's Language & Region setting.
  • Fixed step labels in the top progress bar getting silently truncated with an ellipsis when they didn't fit.

• After your first successful export, WatermarkFactory now offers to walk you through adding a Finder right-click Quick Action for next time -- in-app step-by-step instructions, no automatic filesystem changes.

• New Watermark Intensity control on the Position stage: six named steps from Discrete to Protective (size + opacity + layout together), sized from real market research (10-15% of canvas width is the professional-branding sweet spot). Chip row plus a slider that interpolates between steps.
  • The preview now shows Automality's own mark when you haven't chosen a watermark yet, so the intensity presets are actually visible before you have your own logo ready. Clearly badged as a demo -- never used for a real export.

• Fixed Chat mode: it never actually worked before (10s timeout vs ~28s real model latency meant every message silently fell back to the click-through flow). Now uses gemma3:4b (3-5s/turn), verified live in English and Spanish.
  • Fixed native controls (DisclosureGroup, Picker) showing the Mac's system accent color instead of Automality teal.
  • Added Sparkle auto-update -- this is the first version that can update itself.
